house.name: Dover Haven
house.description: Unit 4, Dover Mews, 2nd Avenue — three bedrooms, three bathrooms and a study, four minutes on foot from Dover Beach.

picks.name: Dover Beach
picks.description: Calm, swimmable water with a lifeguard on duty and plenty of natural shade. Down 2nd Avenue, then along Dover Road to the beach access — flat the whole way.

picks.name: The Dover Market
picks.description: Lena's go-to for small groceries — bread, milk, water and the basics, right up the street.

picks.name: St Lawrence Gap
picks.description: Restaurants, rum shops and live music — somewhere to eat at almost any hour. Lively in the evening, quiet again by the time you're back in bed.

picks.name: Oistins Fish Fry
picks.description: Go on a Friday night for the fish fry — it's the one thing everybody tells guests to do, and they're right.

picks.name: Grantley Adams Airport
picks.description: A transfer can be arranged in advance — just ask when you book.

picks.name: Route Taxis & ZR Vans
picks.description: Run constantly and cost a couple of dollars — the fastest way to Oistins or Bridgetown if you don't mind a squeeze and loud soca.
